description: This Java source file defines the class CborJsonifiableSerializer which extends AbstractJsonifiableWithDittoHeadersSerializer. It provides methods for serializing and deserializing JsonObject instances to and from CBOR format using a CborFactory implementation loaded via ServiceLoader.

classes.name: CborJsonifiableSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that converts JsonObject instances to and from CBOR format using a dynamically loaded CborFactory. It ensures the CborFactory implementation is available and configured to handle CBOR encoding.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer for use with an ExtendedActorSystem.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Serializes a JsonObject into a ByteBuffer using the CBOR factory.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Deserializes CBOR data from a ByteBuffer into a JsonValue.
